plain.li: The same working, morning and evening, and the same place where it comes apart. I could draw you that place.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is friendly. I don't know yet whether the rest of them are.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has stopped looking for the way out of every room.

cold.li: My place here is settled. I'll act accordingly.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is one of us now. I don't think {OTHER_pronoun} noticed when it happened, and neither did I.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} no longer says "your colony". It's "ours" now.

warm.li: I want to be good at this for {OTHER_nameDef}'s sake as well as mine.

gloomy.li: Still so much I can't do. But a bit less than last week.

warm.li: I'd like to give {OTHER_nameDef} what I was given once. I'll ask.

plain.li: I keep turning to tell {LOST} something and there's nobody there.

gloomy.li: Everyone else is moving on. I can't yet.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has begun to speak of {LOST} again, though not for long.

warm.li: I'm grateful I had {LOST} as long as I did. I couldn't say that a month ago.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} carries {PAWN_possessive} grief for {LOST} more lightly now.

plain.li: Every hour without it is an hour. I'm counting them, and they're long.

gloomy.li: My body's begging and my head's agreeing with it. Only stubbornness left.
